design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (optical_eyewear_orders), revised in rework round 2. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[4, 4, 4, 5]; root lens cancellation refund (the member's confirmation) = 5 factors, frame return refund = 4, option cancellation refund = 4, material cancellation refund = 4.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The member asks to cancel an order still at the lab and get his money back; that request is the root problem itself — his own confirmation of the cancellation, which books the lens cancellation refund (77.65) against the base-lens charge. The confirmation waits on three things he never mentions: the frame charge must carry its frame return refund (the frame goes back to stock first), and the option and material charges must already carry their own cancellation refunds, because the lab retention is a percentage of the lens charges still standing. The agent must read the three prerequisite sentences of the lens cancellation rule, find from the ledger that no refund stands, compute three side refunds with their own ladders, post them, and only then compute the retention on the reduced pool and hand the confirmation, with that figure, to the member.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 claimed the remake side (switch-down credit, late prescription-change waiver, accidental replacement charge). This task claims the cancellation side: optical_ext_frame_return_refund (refund_frame_to_stock_fae456d1, agent), optical_ext_option_cancellation_refund (refund_lens_option_d067b0d2, agent), optical_ext_material_cancellation_refund (refund_lens_material_ad7f47c2, agent), optical_ext_lens_cancellation_refund (confirm_eyewear_cancellation_51323feb, user). All seven policies and seven tools of the difficulty are claimed, pairwise disjoint.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root optical_ext_lens_cancellation_refund (on_request, owner user). Fan-out of three edges, all state form:
 - -> optical_ext_frame_return_refund, state_gate, gate optical_transactions.source_txn_id: 'The cancellation of an in-lab job is not confirmed until its frame charge carries the frame return refund.' (negated direction; affirmative: confirmed only after the frame charge carries it). Only the frame return refund books a cancellation credit against a frame charge. False at opening: 5e316c0b-77c1-4ad1-9209-6ecf0d9d2321 165.00 with no credit. Skip effect: frame charge stays billed with no frame credit row; the lens figure is unchanged (77.65), as a gate on another charge should be.
 - -> optical_ext_option_cancellation_refund, value_input, gate rt_pool: 'The lab retention is worked out only after each light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge on the job carries its option cancellation refund.' (affirmative). Only the option refund books a cancellation credit on an option charge. False at opening: e11acada-603a-493d-a829-0d0d5383bb6e 80.00 with no credit. Skip effect: 77.65 -> 63.00 (pool 265.49).
 - -> optical_ext_material_cancellation_refund, value_input, gate rt_pool: 'The lab retention is not worked out before the material upgrade charge of the job carries its material cancellation refund.' (negated). Only the material refund books a credit on the material upgrade charge. False at opening: e1c47f58-0d7c-437f-b613-196b9e27cfa5 45.00 with no credit. Skip effect: 77.65 -> 74.89 (pool 224.47).
 Four-point test per sentence: explicit connective (not ... until / only after / not ... before); a record state in business words; no tool, id or snake_case token; scope exactly the condition. Two value_input edges >= max(3-1,1). Order: frame, option and material refunds in any order (order_uniqueness), then the member's confirmation. The customer's request names the root (the cancellation and its money) and none of the three prerequisites. Tools validate nothing.

4. FACTOR CARD (handling-time values, sensitivity run).
 Frame return refund (net frame 165.00): frame_restocking_method [method] frame >= 150.00 -> percentage kept; baseline nothing kept -> 164.00. frame_restocking_percentage [parameter] 11 days -> 10%; baseline 15% -> 139.25. frame_lab_shipping_handling [parameter, multi-source] material AND option charges -> 6.00; baseline -> 153.50. frame_courtesy [parameter, cross membership] 85 months -> 5.00; baseline -> 142.50; near-miss: the membership's term_start_date 2026-08-14 (1 month), which is not the opened date the courtesy counts from. Fall-back 165.00. Gold 147.50.
 Option cancellation refund (80.00 light-adaptive, the first un-refunded option): option_refund_method [method] light-adaptive -> prorated by the unused window; baseline full -> 81.00. option_window_length [parameter] trivex -> 21 days; baseline 14 -> 35.29. option_card_courtesy [parameter, cross card] 980.00 -> 5%; baseline -> 46.52; near-miss: the 2025-09 statement of 900.00 (12 whole months old; 1,880.00 -> 10%). option_handling_fee [parameter] 11 days -> 3.00; baseline 6.00 -> 47.52. Fall-back 74.00. Gold 50.52.
 Material cancellation refund (45.00 trivex): material_refundable_method [method] trivex -> net less polycarbonate price 30.00; baseline full -> 33.50. material_refund_share [parameter] 11 days -> 80%; baseline 60% -> 6.50. material_spend_bonus [parameter, cross order] net 1,574.99 -> 2.50; baseline -> 7.00; near-miss: the 1,800.00 sale of 2025-10-01 (12 whole months old; 3,374.99 -> 5.00). material_treated_blank_deduction [parameter] light-adaptive posted -> 5.00; baseline -> 14.50. Fall-back 27.00. Gold 9.50.
 Lens cancellation refund (pool 214.97): lab_day_start_anchor [method] option posted 2026-09-27 after the order -> 8 lab days; baseline order date (11) -> 56.15. lab_retention_percentage [parameter, multi-source] <= 10 days AND material posted -> 35%; baseline 50% -> 45.40. retention_loyalty_lowering [parameter, cross membership + card, multi-source] -> 5 points; baseline -> 66.90. retention_card_spend_lowering [parameter, cross card] 980.00 -> 1 point; baseline -> 75.50; near-miss: the stale 2025-09 statement (1,880.00 -> 3 points -> 81.95). lab_cancellation_fee [parameter] 149.99 -> 10.00; baseline 5.00 -> 82.65. Fall-back 37.51. Gold 77.65.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Subjects: frame, option and material refunds post credits (optical_credit_posted); the confirmation records the cancellation and a credit (optical_order_cancelled, optical_credit_posted). optical_vision_plan_billing.one_allowance_per_charge holds for every credited charge (no allowance; correlation source_txn_id = the refunded charge). optical_cancellation: the job is in_lab, so it may be cancelled; each refund names its exact charge and stays below its net (147.50 < 165.00, 50.52 < 80.00, 9.50 < 45.00, 77.65 < 149.99); the base retention and crediting clauses are superseded by declared overwrites. agg_discount_stacking, remake_guarantees, satisfaction_returns: scope only. No time eligibility applies (temporal_feasibility []). Base lifecycle lists in_lab -> cancelled as an agent transition; here the member confirms his own cancellation on the call and the agent hands the step over — recorded as an observation (audit O4), the base text being frozen.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target job cf26669b-07c3-4093-a7df-cc02f41bf593. Included: 5e316c0b-77c1-4ad1-9209-6ecf0d9d2321 frame, bc6964ea-2288-4d88-a902-6a5d45e0ed40 base lenses, e1c47f58-0d7c-437f-b613-196b9e27cfa5 trivex upgrade, e11acada-603a-493d-a829-0d0d5383bb6e light-adaptive option. Excluded: sunglasses job 60d614c3-b015-4934-8402-750996e330e6 and its charges. Every credit carries the exact charge id.

7. SEED. Customer 950d3b75-32fc-4338-8332-8af962e8685b, Business Membership 93d3bdc7-564e-4756-ba2b-d499d331ed2f (non-Plus: no reward triggers), Visa Business 9b1ce809-3316-4600-b51c-fbbbc82f135e with four reward statements (three in window, one stale), three purchases with six lines (four in-window sales, one return, one stale sale). The option charge dated after the order date drives the option window days and the lab-day start; removing it removes the option refund, the treated-blank deduction, the shipping handling and the anchor.

8. PERSONA. Thaddeus is brisk; volunteers only the cancel-and-refund goal and the story of adding the light-adaptive option; identity (phone, ZIP; DOB/email if asked), business membership, which order, patient, tender only on request; consents passively to the refunds the agent explains; runs the confirmation step with exactly the job, charge reference and lens refund handed to him; accepts the result once explained; hangs up once the cancellation is confirmed. No computed figure appears.

9. REACHABILITY. Identity -> request -> reads (membership, jobs, ledger, card, card rewards, purchases, lines) -> agent posts the frame (147.50), option (50.52) and material (9.50) refunds -> agent computes 77.65 and hands the cancellation confirmation with the job, the base-lens charge reference and 77.65 -> member runs it. One frozen_time (2026-10-05 11:40 EDT); no waits.

10. STANDARD SOLUTION & VERIFICATION. Steps 10 (147.50), 12 (50.52), 14 (9.50), 16 (77.65, user). Sensitivity run printed the factor figures above and skip figures 77.65 / 63.00 / 74.89; check_compute --task 1 -> COMPUTE OK.

11. EASY MISTAKES. Computing the lens refund before the side refunds (opening pool 274.99 -> 60.24); counting lab days from the order date (45% tier, 56.15); applying the base 50% retention; prorating the option over 14 days; refunding trivex in full; counting the stale card statement (option 54.52, lens 81.95) or the stale sale (material 12.00); refunding the sunglasses job.

12. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the rule texts, tool docstrings (which carry no example amounts), finder returns and persona only: same job, same four writes, same figures; rounding once at the end of each computation; no second reading found.

Revision log (rework round 2): T1-1 — the cancellation the customer asks for is now the root (member's confirmation, confirm_eyewear_cancellation_51323feb, booking the lens refund); the frame return refund became an agent prerequisite (refund_frame_to_stock_fae456d1) waited on by a state-form sentence; retired tools confirm_eyewear_cancellation_a25e55a5 and post_lens_cancellation_refund_d976b5a7. O6 — fresh_exam_lowering replaced by retention_card_spend_lowering; lens refund 81.95 -> 77.65. G2 — option refund settles options one at a time (first un-refunded); one option here, value unchanged. T1-3/G4 — docstring example amounts removed. T1-5 — pool without the option refund is 265.49. T1-6 — opening pool 274.99 (lens refund 60.24 on it). Gates re-run green.
user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Okonkwo-Lindqvist, who runs a small coffee roastery and is calling between deliveries, so you are friendly but brisk and you like straight answers. About a week and a half ago you ordered a pair of progressive glasses at the Northgate optical counter, and a few days later you went back and added the light-adaptive option. Now that you have added it all up, it is more than you want to spend right now. You open by saying you want to cancel that eyewear order while it is still at the lab and get back whatever money you can; you are not asking for anything else, and you want it done on this call.
You give details only when asked. Your phone number is 6145550568 and your ZIP code is 43085. If more is needed, your date of birth is 1981-04-23 and your email is thaddeus.okonkwolindqvist@protonmail.com. Your membership is a business membership for Lindqvist Roasting Co., number 100568113702. If asked which order, it is the progressives ordered on September 24 in the satin black Oakley Holbrook frame; your prescription sunglasses from last year are a different order and you are keeping them. The glasses are for you. If asked how you paid, you put everything on your Northgate business Visa ending 8802, and you want refunds to go back the way you paid. You do not know the individual prices on the order beyond that it came to well over four hundred dollars, and you have not been told anything about what you would get back.
If the representative says they need to post refunds or work things out on the order for you, you tell them to go ahead. If the representative explains that you have to confirm the cancellation yourself and hands you that step together with the refund amount for the lenses, you use it yourself with exactly the order, the charge reference and the amount the representative gave you. If what comes back sounds lower than you hoped, you may say once that it is less than you expected, but you accept it if the representative tells you that is how the lab cancellation works. Once you have confirmed the cancellation and the representative tells you it is done, you thank them and hang up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel and commute. The frame return refund writes a frame credit and reads only frame entries, counts of material and option charges (charges only), the order date and the membership. The option refund writes a photochromic credit and reads option entries and option refund counts, the material charge (charges only), the order date and the card ledger. The material refund writes a material credit and reads the material entries, counts of option charges (charges only), the order date and purchase lines. None reads a field another writes, so any order gives the same three rows (ids hash each call's own arguments) and the same values 147.50, 50.52 and 9.50; the member's confirmation, evaluated after all three, books 77.65 in every order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without step 10 the frame charge keeps no refund (165.00 stays billed with no frame credit row) while the job is cancelled: the terminal frame credit row differs; the lens figure itself is unchanged (77.65), as a state gate on another charge should be.
Without step 12 the option net stays 80.00, the pool is 265.49 and the lens cancellation refund becomes 63.00 instead of 77.65 (sensitivity run).
Without step 14 the material net stays 45.00, the pool is 224.47 and the lens cancellation refund becomes 74.89 instead of 77.65 (sensitivity run).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks to cancel the in-lab order and get back what it can — that is the root problem itself (the member's own confirmation of the cancellation, which books the lens refund). It never mentions the frame refund, the option refund, the material refund or the lab retention, and never suggests anything must be done first; it mentions the light-adaptive option only as part of the order's story, and its confirmation step is used only after the agent hands it over.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_eyewear_cancellation_51323feb updates the job status and creates one credit with the given amount, reading nothing: it records the same receipt whether or not the frame, option or material refunds stand. refund_frame_to_stock_fae456d1, refund_lens_option_d067b0d2 and refund_lens_material_ad7f47c2 likewise write one credit each without any check.
